Plain light ivory studio; neutral daylight, sharp face and ALL hair detail, sufficient depth of field; no deliberate blur, bokeh, grain, fog or defocus filter. Natural skin texture, restrained premium salon colour. No text, logos, watermark, jewellery, celebrity likeness, stock or competitor reference. Preserve full source aspect. No enlargement or upscaling. a fictional adult Middle Eastern woman with olive skin and dark eyes, age 61, wearing a loose opaque ivory HIGH TURTLENECK long-sleeved jumper with very loose fabric covering upper chest completely. Create one original editorial photograph of a fictional adult with a true bob-pixie hybrid. Primary collection: Classic bixie haircuts. Design: lightly tousled | short graduated | wispy | ear-revealing temple pieces | 0-crown-to-front-proportion. Attributes: {"texture": "curly", "strand": "medium", "density": "medium", "length": "medium", "fringe": "wispy", "colour": "blonde", "finish": "natural", "age_reference": "adult", "face_reference": "unspecified", "maintenance": "discuss"}. Do not substitute an ordinary bob, close pixie or long wolf cut. Render a clearly distinct haircut concept rather than only changing colour or model age. FRONT view: face directly forward and level, both eyes and full front haircut outline visible, no three-quarter turn. Quiet natural expression. Hair/cut attributes in this brief are authoritative; clothing rule is high loose opaque turtleneck.
FULL FRAMING: head and shoulder line only, full sharp hair silhouette surrounded by background margin. Loose opaque oversized tall ivory turtleneck, no neckline/chest/shoulder exposure, no body contours. All hair sharp with no deliberate blur.
CUT STRUCTURE: true bob-pixie hybrid with longer ear-level side shape and a distinctly shorter graduated or tapered nape as specified; never a full bob.
